hero.title: Run your whole madrasa from one place
hero.subtitle: MMS helps madrasas take attendance, manage students and ustazes, run exams and keep parents informed, in the language you prefer.

features.title: Everything a madrasa needs
features.subtitle: Simple tools for administrators and ustazes, built to work well on any phone.

attendance.title: Daily attendance
attendance.description: Ustazes mark present, absent or late in seconds. Administrators see the full picture right away.

students.title: Student records
students.description: Keep every student's class, photo and parent contact details in one tidy place.

exams.title: Exams and results
exams.description: Create exams, enter marks and print clear result sheets for each class.

parents.title: Parent follow-up
parents.description: Students with repeated absences are flagged automatically, with their parent's phone number ready to call.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Charts for attendance trends, grades and class sizes help you spot problems early.

languages.title: Many madrasas, many languages
languages.description: Each madrasa has its own private space, and every user can choose their own language.
